page.overview:
Who is Grease-Wheel?

Grease-Wheel is a character who appears in the G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game by Renegade Game Studios. He is used as a part of the introductory adventure, Snake Pit.

QR is a Motor-Viper. He is a member of Scar Squad, who serves as the team's getaway driver. He spends his time whining and complaining, but Faceless seems to be willing to give him whatever he wants. During the course of the adventure, he steals a G.I. Joe A.P.C. so that the team can escape.

G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game (Renegade Game Studios) pg 318. "Snake Pit Introductory Adventure."
